rules: P2 DECISION-AUTHORITY.md §3 A1-A9 with the §5 v0.2 changes C1-C5

decisions.statement: The quote's payable-by date uses the payment-terms decision in force, DEC-B12 (21 days after today), not the superseded DEC-B01 (30 days) that issueInvoice still applies. This matches the requirement's example (2026-03-02 -> 2026-03-23).

Invoice issuing keeps its existing 30-day due date (DEC-B01). Moving invoices to DEC-B12 is not asked by BILL-41, would change existing behaviour and break BaseTests; left as an open question. As a result a quote and an invoice issued the same day currently show different dates.

Quote amounts are validated with the existing Commands.parseAmount (positive, at most two decimals, no sign), the customer is checked before nothing else; the amount is echoed in two-decimal format. The quote changes no state.
Added `quote <customer> <amount>` to Cli.usage directly after the invoice line, and to the README command list in the same position.
